svg.text: FIGURE 5 · ANATOMY OF A CLAIM

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: Four assertions about a private citizen

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: Posted January 2025 by the official account of the State of Israel, concerning Zahwa Arafat — born 1995, no public

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: office, never charged with anything, anywhere.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', 'SF Mono', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace
'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: She is worth $8 billion

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: No filing, registry entry, audit, court record or named source has ever been

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: produced.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', 'SF Mono', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: UNEVIDENCED

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', 'SF Mono', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace
'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: She owns prime real estate across London

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: No title record, company filing or address has ever been produced.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', 'SF Mono', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: UNEVIDENCED

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', 'SF Mono', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace
'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: She lives in Paris

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: She has lived in Malta since childhood. Wire photographs filed from her family's

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: Malta home in 2011 and 2012; family interviews from 2009 to 2025; a degree from a

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: Maltese university.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', 'SF Mono', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: FALSE — AND CHECKABLE

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', 'SF Mono', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace
'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: She is eligible for UNRWA funds as a refugee

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: No evidence has been offered that she has ever registered with, applied to, or

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: received anything from UNRWA.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', 'SF Mono', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: UNEVIDENCED

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', 'SF Mono', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: If the easiest verifiable detail in a four-sentence claim is wrong,

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', 'SF Mono', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: ask what standard of care was applied to the other three.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', 'SF Mono', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: The post remains publicly visible. No correction has been issued.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', 'SF Mono', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: TIMES OF PALESTINE
